label: Pricing Strategy
description: Develop and evaluate pricing strategies, models, and structures. Covers value-based pricing, competitive pricing analysis, price sensitivity, discounting frameworks, and pricing communication.

guidedInputs.label: What pricing challenge are you solving?
Product or service being priced
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., AML compliance advisory services, sold as project-based engagements or retainer. Current pricing is daily rate EUR 1,500-2,500 per consultant.

guidedInputs.label: Current pricing (if applicable)
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Day rates: EUR 1,800 junior, EUR 2,200 senior, EUR 2,800 partner. Typical project: EUR 200-500k. Blended margin: 35%.

guidedInputs.label: Competitor pricing (known or estimated)
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Big 4 charge EUR 2,500-4,000/day, boutiques charge EUR 1,200-1,800/day, offshore/nearshore firms charge EUR 600-900/day

guidedInputs.label: Constraints or considerations
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Must maintain 40% gross margin, key client expects 10% volume discount, procurement prefers fixed-fee over T&M, public sector clients have maximum rate caps
